plugins.name: Tuff Agents
plugins.author: trickortree
plugins.description: An AI helper in a sidebar on the right, a bit like GitHub Copilot. Ask Claude Code, Codex or Antigravity about your code, or let them make changes. They get Tuff's docs and can check and run your programs through TuffCode's MCP tools.

plugins.name: Snippet Library
plugins.author: trickortree
plugins.description: Ready-made bits of Tuff you can drop into your code: loops, functions, live lines, app windows, buttons, timers and more. Save your own from any selection too.

newer.name: API Explorer
newer.author: trickortree
newer.description: Try a web API and see what comes back. Click any value in the answer to get the Tuff code that reaches it with tap, or a whole program that runs. Comes with examples to try, and keeps your last 20 requests.

newer.name: Sprite Studio
newer.author: trickortree
newer.description: Draw pixel-art sprites and icons for your games and apps. Animate them with frames, save them as PNG pictures in your project, and get the Tuff code that shows them in tgame, mtgui or atgui.
newer.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M15.6 4.4a2 2 0 0 1 2.8 0l1.2 1.2a2 2 0 0 1 0 2.8L10.5 17.5 6 18.5l1-4.5z"/><path d="M13.8 6.2l4 4"/><path fill="#000" stroke="none" d="M2.5 19.5h3v3h-3zM2.5 14h3v3h-3z"/></svg>

newer.name: Sound Lab
newer.author: trickortree
newer.description: Make sound effects for your tgame games: coins, jumps, lasers, explosions and more. Pick a preset, move the sliders, play it, then save it as a .wav file and add it to your game with one line of code.
